intro: Eritrea, on the Red Sea, won independence from Ethiopia in 1993 after a 30-year war.

chapters.title: Ancient ports
text: The port of Adulis was the gateway of the Kingdom of Aksum, trading with Rome, Arabia and India. Qohaito has ancient ruins.

chapters.title: Italian colony
text: Italy made Eritrea its colony in 1890. Asmara was rebuilt with modernist buildings in the 1930s and is now a World Heritage site. Britain ran it after 1941, and in 1952 it was federated with Ethiopia, which annexed it in 1962.

highlight.title: Asmara
highlight.text: Its 1930s modernist architecture earned it the nickname 'Africa's Little Rome'.

chapters.title: Independence
text: A liberation war led to victory in 1991 and independence after a referendum in 1993. A border war with Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000 killed tens of thousands; peace was made in 2018.
